inputs.sbc_source: No share option or share award scheme expense in the FY2018-FY2025 annual reports or H1 FY2026 interim; issued shares unchanged at 2,797,223,396 throughout. SBC-zero market: SBC rows kept at 0%.
inputs.share_count_basis: 2,797,223,396 issued shares at 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim, capital structure section); basic = diluted (no dilutive securities, basic and diluted EPS identical). Held flat; no buybacks ever, no SBC, so the flat count is the actual history, not a convention.
inputs.fx_note: Statements are in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote is HKD. 1 CNY = 1.1721 HKD (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-10T03:38Z; CNHHKD=X 1.1720 agrees). Direction check: the FY2025 final dividend of HK17.7c/share was booked as RMB430.772m on 2,797.2m shares = RMB0.1540/share, implying 1.149 HKD/CNY at the March-2026 declaration -- same direction and order, the ~2% gap being RMB appreciation since. All per-share values are computed in CNY and converted to HKD; unsuffixed values are HKD.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T08:08:06Z regular close (HKEX), Yahoo Finance chart API
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows, consistent with the HK-listed China staples in this folder (0220.HK, 0322.HK at 8.0%): China 10y government bond ~1.9% + beta ~0.85 (defensive beverage bottler) x China ERP ~7.0% = ~7.9%, rounded to 8.0%. All-equity: no bank borrowings since FY2021, so WACC = cost of equity. Same rate in every scenario -- licensor dependence, China consumption and water-mix margin risk are carried in the scenario flows and weights, not in the rate (risk charged once).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: lease liabilities RMB68.3m at 31-Dec-2025 (39.587 current + 28.688 non-current) are in total_debt; lease principal (RMB52.8m FY2025) is NOT deducted from the flows; right-of-use depreciation sits inside D&A and renewal is carried by the capex line. Immaterial either way (<0.3% of revenue); right-of-use assets are mostly PRC land-use rights.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, attributable basis. Consolidated revenue/EBITDA/D&A/capex are modelled, and the NCI profit share (FY2025 RMB566.1m = 35% Coca-Cola Company stake in COFCO Coca-Cola, RMB419.9m, plus minorities inside COFCO Coca-Cola's own subsidiaries, RMB146.1m) is folded into a combined tax/leakage rate of 57%: 1 - (1 - 28% cash tax) x (1 - ~40% NCI share). Calibration: FY2025 EBIT ~RMB1,928m x 0.43 = RMB829m vs attributable net income RMB862m less after-tax interest income ~RMB40m = RMB822m (ties within 1%). Because the JV holds essentially all the group's cash (JV current assets RMB7,885m vs group RMB8,107m), the NCI's ~40% look-through claim on consolidated net cash is deducted in the equity bridge; the NCI book balance (RMB3,665m) is NOT deducted, which would double-charge. Residual approximation: capex in excess of D&A and the working-capital release are charged/credited at 100% rather than ~60%, a net RMB<30m/yr, conservative.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component route, with the non-US adaptations (currency-matched CNY WACC, CNY->HKD fx bridge, NCI charged once, lease treatment A, SBC-zero). Routed as an operating company (consumer staples bottler) per dcf-methods SKILL.md; first valuation of this ticker, no prior model in memory. Identity: China Foods Limited (COFCO subsidiary, Coca-Cola bottler for 19 provinces via the 65%-owned COFCO Coca-Cola JV) -- not China Resources Power, an earlier mis-brief. Net cash uses the 31-Dec-2025 balance sheet, deliberately, not the later 30-Jun-2026 interim: FY0 is FY2025 and year 1 is FY2026, so the June cash (RMB5,898m) already contains H1 FY2026 FCF that the year-1 projection counts again, plus RMB483m of dividends declared but unpaid at 30 June (RMB430.8m to owners, RMB52.2m to NCI) and a seasonal peak-season working-capital float (~RMB470m more favourable than December). Netting those gives ~RMB4.95bn, i.e. the June figure reconciles to December plus ~RMB400m of H1 retained FCF. Share count is from the 30-Jun-2026 interim (unchanged since FY2018). FY2025 reported FCF (OCF 3,229 - capex 1,061) was flattered by a +RMB442m contract-liability (distributor advances) swing; the component build does not carry that forward. No buybacks: the flat count is the company's actual history.

equity_bridge.item: NCI look-through share of consolidated net cash (~39.6% = FY2025 NCI profit 566.1 / profit incl. NCI 1,428.0, x net cash 4,481)
equity_bridge.note: Cash sits inside COFCO Coca-Cola (35% Coca-Cola Company) and its part-owned subsidiaries; FY2025 AR note 34(b) summarised financials. Flows are attributable via the leakage rate, so the NCI claim on the cash is charged here and only here.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: revenue path anchored on H1 FY2026 revenue +4.0% YoY and the 3yr/5yr revenue CAGRs (1.7%/5.1%), not the equity CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 6.8% diverges >30% from revenue 5yr CAGR 5.1% and from EPS 5yr CAGR 11.6%. Equity growth reflects retained earnings in a net-cash business that pays out ~50% and parks the rest as cash; EPS growth is margin expansion (net margin 2.9% -> 3.9%) on slow volume. Neither is a sustainable top-line rate, so the forward path is revenue-based.
historical_growth.notes: SBC is zero, so owner FCF = reported FCF - interest income; the owner-FCF CAGRs equal reported-FCF CAGRs less the small interest strip. The 3yr FCF CAGR (108%) is meaningless off the FY2022 trough (RMB233m owner FCF after a working-capital reversal and RMB889m capex); FY2023-25 owner FCF averaged ~RMB1,970m consolidated.

base.ebitda_margin_rationale: FY2024 12.7%, FY2025 13.0%; H1 FY2026 14.8% vs 14.5% in H1 FY2025 (peak-season half) -- distribution-cost efficiency offsetting a 1.4pp gross-margin drag from water mix. Base drifts +0.5pp to 13.5% and holds.
base.capex_rationale: Capex 3.0% / 3.6% / 4.8% of revenue FY2023-25 (FY2025 includes the Shaanxi digital-intelligent factory); H1 FY2026 3.4%. Held slightly above D&A (4.3%) for a growing bottler.
base.wc_rationale: Negative working capital (distributor advances, accrued marketing, fridge deposits exceed inventory + receivables; ~-17% of revenue at Dec-2025), so growth releases cash; 8% of the revenue increase is a conservative capture.
base.cash_tax_rate_rationale: Combined tax + NCI leakage: 28% cash tax (FY2025 cash tax paid RMB548m on PBT ~RMB1,979m, PRC 25% plus dividend withholding) and ~40% NCI share of profit. See inputs.nci_treatment.

scenario_narratives.base: The 19-province Coca-Cola franchise keeps compounding volume at low single digits in a soft, price-deflationary Chinese beverage market: sugar-free sparkling and Monster/Predator energy grow fast, water grows volume at thin margin, juice shrinks. Revenue grows ~3.5% near-term (H1 FY2026 +4%) fading to 2.5%, and distribution-cost efficiency and the digital factories roughly offset the water-mix gross-margin drag, lifting EBITDA margin half a point to 13.5%. Innovative businesses (vending, Yuexiang Club, nutrition foods) stay immaterial. The JV with The Coca-Cola Company is stable and dividends keep flowing at ~50% payout with cash accumulating.
scenario_narratives.bull: Sugar-free and functional drinks keep taking share, RFP channel partners open lower-tier markets and smart-vending scale lifts on-premise mix: revenue grows 4.5-5% for several years and EBITDA margin climbs to 14.5% as digital-intelligent plants cut unit costs and the mix moves away from water. The nutrition/health-food 'second curve' begins to contribute. Terminal growth 2.5% reflects a franchise still gaining share at the end of the decade.
scenario_narratives.bear: Price war with Nongfu Spring, Master Kong and domestic sugar-free challengers, plus weak Chinese consumption, keeps volume flat and price negative; water keeps diluting gross margin and The Coca-Cola Company presses concentrate pricing or bottler economics, so EBITDA margin slides to 12.0%. Revenue grows ~1%/yr. The franchise survives (no territory loss is modelled -- that tail is the reason for the bear weight, not a scenario of its own), but the business is an ex-growth cash cow.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 25%: the entire business rests on one licensor's franchise and JV partner, and Chinese beverage pricing is deflationary with gross margin already falling. Base 55%: H1 FY2026 (+4% revenue, margin up) sits on the base path. Bull cut to 20%: it needs both share gains in sugar-free/energy and margin expansion against a water-heavy mix, two things going right at once.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A net-cash, no-SBC, ~50%-payout SOE consumer staple whose value is the attributable (~60%) share of a mature Coca-Cola bottling franchise's free cash flow plus its share of the cash pile. The valuation hinges on three things: the NCI leakage being charged once (via the combined rate, with the NCI share of cash deducted), a slow-growth revenue path, and an EBITDA margin that holds 12-14.5% against water-mix dilution. Value is computed in CNY and reported in HKD at the CNY/HKD rate in fx_note.
key_risks_to_valuation: Franchise/licensor dependence: any change in the Coca-Cola Company bottling agreement, territory or concentrate pricing hits the whole value
Chinese beverage price deflation and water-mix gross-margin dilution (gross margin -0.7pp FY2025, -1.4pp H1 FY2026)
NCI look-through approximation: ~40% leakage rate assumed stable; a change in Coca-Cola's 35% or in sub-level minorities moves it
SOE capital allocation: cash keeps accumulating at a low yield rather than being returned; the bridge credits it at face value
CNY/HKD rate is a dated snapshot; refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate

data_sources.fx: Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X at the date in inputs.fx_note
